name: Cornerstone Phones
author: Kush Beaver Productionz
description: Battery levels and noise-cancelling control for Bluetooth headphones in the Omarchy bar. Motorola, Sony, JBL, Samsung, Nothing and CMF, Soundcore, Xiaomi, Redmi, OPPO, Bose, TOZO, Huawei and EarFun; battery on anything with Google Fast Pair or a BlueZ battery figure.

barWidget.description: One icon per connected set, filling with its battery. The panel shows left, right and case, and switches Off, ANC and Ambient where the headphones allow, with the extra controls some models have: an Ambient level, an ANC strength, low latency, TOZO's extra modes.

schema.label: Device name or address contains
schema.description: Leave empty to show every connected audio device; set a substring to follow only the matching ones.

schema.label: Read battery over Google Fast Pair
schema.description: Left, right and case levels over the Fast Pair channel. Off: the battery comes from the headphones' own channel where a bridge reads it, otherwise from BlueZ's single figure. JBL noise control needs Fast Pair for its BLE address; every other brand works without it.

schema.label: Noise cancellation (Off / ANC / Ambient)
schema.description: The MODE row in the panel, which also follows changes made on the headphones. Works on Moto Buds+, Sony (MDR v1 and v2), Samsung Galaxy Buds2, Nothing and CMF, Soundcore, Xiaomi Buds 5 Pro, Redmi Buds 5 and 3 Pro, OPPO Enco Air3 Pro, Bose QC45 and QC35, TOZO NC9 Pro, EarFun Air Pro 4, JBL Tour Pro 3 and some other JBL earbuds (those need Fast Pair). Hidden on headphones that answer for none.

schema.label: Show a percentage instead of the drawn meters
schema.description: On: the lower earbud's percentage next to the icon, taking a second bar slot. Off: the levels fill the two halves of one drawn icon. A vertical bar always draws the icon.

schema.label: Hide the widget while nothing is connected
Send a notification at the low battery threshold
Pause media when a device disconnects or comes off your ears
schema.description: Pauses every playing media player when followed headphones disconnect (switched off, out of range) and, on headphones with a wear sensor, the moment they come off your ears. Putting them back on resumes exactly those players.
